items.name: Turkey Club
items.description: Sliced turkey, bacon, lettuce, tomato, mayo on white or wheat. Served with chips.

items.name: Loaded Fries
items.description: Crispy fries piled with steak, cheese, onions, peppers, chipotle mayo, and mayo.

items.name: Tacos
items.description: Three corn tortillas with cheese, chipotle mayo, pico de gallo, and cilantro. Choose steak, chicken, or shrimp.

items.name: Quesadilla
items.description: Flour tortilla with cheese and your choice of meat. Sour cream and pico on the side.

items.name: Cheesesteak
items.description: Sub roll with steak, onions, peppers, mozzarella, and mayo.

items.name: Taco Bowl
items.description: Fried flour tortilla bowl with black beans, corn, pico, jalapeño, avocado, and sour cream. Steak or chicken.

items.name: Burrito
items.description: Flour tortilla with rice, black beans, corn, pico, lettuce, and sour cream. Steak or chicken.

items.name: Empanadas
items.description: Fried pastry with cheese, beef, chicken, or ham. Comes with 2.

items.name: Chicken Tenders
items.description: Golden crispy tenders with fries and dipping sauce. Ask about today's price.
